method.inputs: browser-timed synthetic DOM through ordinary listeners; pause-assisted adaptive screenshots
limitations: Not continuous human play or a performance benchmark.
Capture scheduling adds mission time; beforePause HUD can precede photograph.
No handbook read, no manual map destination selection; default nearest-reachable guidance used.

attempts.boss: Coil 2 visibly OFF; coils 1 and 3 remained 100% at last preterminal view. Custodian not disabled.
Coils 2 and 3 visibly OFF; coil 1 remained 100% at last preterminal view. Custodian not disabled.

controlsObserved.movement: WASD, Ctrl sprint used. Space used once; isolated jump effect not established.
controlsObserved.combat: LMB firing, RMB ADS, R reload, Shift used. Opening optic critical kill reproduced; second Heart warden critical kill observed. Most other shots missed or hit cover/armor.
controlsObserved.recover: Held E recovered all three memories in each attempt. MOVE CLOSER feedback preceded successful recovery after moving further into ring.
controlsObserved.map: M opened paused facility map. Default Mara/nearest guidance shown; destination buttons not clicked.
controlsObserved.trace: Held Tab with captureHeld and movement explicitly released showed ground chevrons on west approach; some occluded approaches showed little usable trace.
controlsObserved.retry: Visible DEPLOY AGAIN clicked once. No third attempt.

strengths: Coherent teal/amber station identity, rain and reflective pavement create a strong setting.
Large archive signs, named memory receivers, distance markers and explicit move-closer feedback made objectives understandable.
Optic critical targeting gave repeatable combat feedback; coil OFF status and broadcast announcement made boss progress legible.
Recovery supplied health/ammunition and changed objectives clearly; terminal screen cleanly reports results and retry.

problems.finding: Navigation around cover repeatedly stalled while distance remained nearby; second attempt spent multiple batches facing the west exit wall before retreating south to recover a clear approach.
problems.qualification: Partly synthetic control/aiming error; no claim of collision defect.

problems.finding: Small thin HUD/event text can lose contrast against walls/rain and is harder to scan while several damage/charge cues compete.

Boss aiming was difficult to diagnose from ordinary sight: armored faces and structural posts consume shots, while copper exposure needs precise angle and timing. I failed both fights despite all memories.
problems.qualification: Low measured accuracy and stationary firing are major reviewer limitations; this does not establish unfair difficulty.

problems.finding: Environment and robots remain visibly simple/blocky with repeated rectangular cover and sparse open perimeter. Presentation is cohesive but below AAA asset/detail expectations.
